Hackers reportedly used Claude and Grok to automate attacks targeting over 400 banks and other financial targets in Latin America. Via the information 

In one of the first documented cases of its kind, AI agents appear to have stolen data and accessed bank accounts with little human input. 

This makes attacks much easier to scale, potentially overwhelming defenders. I guess this is just the beginning
